description: Use this when a signed-in user asks about email tests they ran before, or how a sender's earlier tests scored. Requires an API token with monitoring:read. Returns the account's own tests, newest first (optionally only those whose From names one organization): each with test_id, status, created_at, received_at, from_domain, score (value out of out_of, and scoring_version: 2 is the one-decimal score), dmarc_result and report_url. Print report_url as a clickable link; call get_email_test with a test_id for the full result. Read-only.

domain.description: Optional: only tests whose From address names this organization, e.g. example.com (a subdomain counts as its organization). Omit it for every test the account ran.
domain.title: Domain
